verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs show the core path. You sign up in the Dashboard for self-serve API keys and clone a runnable Quickstart app. You test in a free, fully featured Sandbox with unlimited test Items, and the /sandbox/public_token/create endpoint creates linked Items programmatically. An official Node client library (plaid-node) is evidenced on GitHub. Missing for 10: evidence of official client libraries in languages beyond Node, independent or hands-on corroboration of how fast signup-to-first-link actually is.
